title: Jamaican Stew
description: A flavorful stew made with aromatic spices and hearty vegetables, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is free from animal products, making it suitable for vegans.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add onion, bell pepper, and carrots. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the potatoes, tomato, and stew. Stir to combine.
Add aromatic and Jamaican spices. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with rice or bread for a filling meal.
